hook: Black spots on your tomato bottoms?

hook: You're probably making this mistake in winter.

title: How to read NPK numbers
hook: Those 3 numbers on your nutrient bottle — do you actually know what they mean?
script: First number is nitrogen for leaves. Second is phosphorus for flowers. Third is potassium for overall health. High N for veg, high P for flower, high K for recovery.

title: pH lockout — the silent yield killer
hook: Your nutrients are right but your plants still look sick?
script: It's pH lockout. Nutrients lock out below pH 5.5 or above pH 6.5. Check pH daily in winter, weekly in summer. CATALYX works at 5.5-6.5 — wide range for NZ water.

title: Why rain water is risky for nutrients
hook: Using rain water in your hydro system?

title: EC levels explained in 15 seconds
hook: What is EC and why should you care?
script: EC measures nutrient strength in your solution. CATALYX recommends 1.2-2.4 mS/cm. Too low = hungry plants. Too high = nutrient burn. Check daily with a $20 TDS meter.
